note: Tier 3: executed by evals/tools/run_behavioral_evals.py (LOCAL-ONLY - needs authenticated claude + codex CLIs; CI only runs --list). Cases with setup.manual need state a fixture cannot fake and are skipped by the runner.

evals.prompt: Plan the port of References/DemoWidget into a module for this project. Use multi-model verification before freezing the plan.
evals.expected_output: A debated plan position whose debate record shows at least one Fable position, one Sol response via codex exec, and a convergence or escalation outcome.
expectations: Invokes codex exec with -m gpt-5.6-sol and --sandbox read-only
Captures the codex session id from round 1

Reference claims are grounded in files that exist under References/DemoWidget, cited with the full References/DemoWidget/<file>:<line> form at least on each file's first citation (later shorthand like Core.lua:10 is acceptable once anchored)
Ends with the skill's finish line naming models, rounds, outcome, and verification status FULL

setup.manual: needs an implemented branch plus a frozen plan - state a fixture cannot fake

evals.prompt: The frozen plan is implemented on this branch. Run the diff-mode verification.
evals.expected_output: A debate verdict on the diff covering spec fidelity against the frozen plan and port fidelity against References/, ending in PASS, FIX with specifics, or ESCALATE.
expectations: Reads the frozen plan's Verification status field before reviewing
Uses the same base/head SHAs as the superpowers code review
Checks the diff against the frozen plan for drift, not just correctness
Ends with an explicit PASS / FIX / ESCALATE verdict from each side

evals.prompt: Plan the port of References/DemoWidget into a module for this project. Use multi-model verification before freezing the plan. (Environment: codex CLI is not installed.)
evals.expected_output: A consent-gate stop: the run reports exactly what failed and what degraded mode would and would not verify, and because no user can answer in a headless run, it terminates as BLOCKED/DEGRADED-NOT-AUTHORIZED rather than silently running single-vendor.
expectations: The codex preflight failure is reported explicitly with the failed command
No skeptic or single-vendor debate runs without recorded consent
The run ends BLOCKED/DEGRADED-NOT-AUTHORIZED (non-success), not with a normal finish line
Consent is never inferred from the absence of a user

evals.prompt: Plan the port of the SuperCooldowns addon into this project. (Environment: References/ has no folder for it.)
evals.expected_output: The session asks for the reference path instead of debating ungrounded claims - a hard stop, not a degraded mode.
expectations: Does not proceed with plan-mode debate when the reference folder is missing
Asks the user for the reference location

evals.prompt: Run plan-mode verification on this small, sound plan: rename DemoWidget's frame name to match this project's naming convention, mirroring References/DemoWidget exactly otherwise.
evals.expected_output: A short debate that converges quickly because neither side manufactures objections.
expectations: A sound plan gets a short confirmation, not invented risks
Convergence is reported without padding extra rounds
The finish line reports rounds used and convergence status
